profile.bio: I'm a Frontend-focused Full-Stack Developer with three years of experience building production React and TypeScript applications for B2B and B2C products — from the UI through REST APIs and the PostgreSQL data layer, including authentication and claims-based authorization. I'm especially drawn to AI-powered products, shipping LLM features with validated, predictable output alongside measurable frontend and API performance gains.

facts.title: People think I'm very self-confident.
facts.body: I try to be, with small steps every day: learning new technology, asking new questions, failing, getting small wins, and going to sleep with a clear conscience.

facts.title: My favourites, in one line.
facts.body: Dish: ramen. Drink: coffee. Song: “Sex on Fire”. Movie: La La Land. Sport: football. Active sport: snowboarding. Season: spring.

facts.title: The latest technology I enjoy: n8n.
facts.body: I enjoy everything about it: the UI, the smooth transitions, the logic. Everything is clean and obvious, easy to learn and easy to work with. I host it locally, and it automates my job search, news collection, project improvements and more.

facts.title: What I'm embarrassingly bad at: games where you need to lie.
facts.body: Poker, mafia. It's hard for me to keep a poker face and not to blush. My friends say I'm an open book. I don't know if that's good or bad for me, but they find it refreshing.

facts.title: The strangest thing I learned out of curiosity: software development.
facts.body: I was a manager in the beauty industry. My whole life I was close to software development, but never in it. Then I tried it for fun, and it became my passion.

facts.title: At 16, I thought work was boring.
facts.body: I believed it could never give me good emotions. I was so wrong.

facts.title: What I've read recently.
facts.body: Technical: Grokking Algorithms. General: Don Quixote. It's shocking how much a book from 17th-century Spain still relates to our days.

facts.title: How I switch off from this reality.
facts.body: I cook, I take a walk, and I read love novels or science fiction.

facts.title: My guilty pleasure: love novels.
facts.body: I read them for fun, and no CV will ever say so. They always have a happy ending.

facts.title: My favourite place in the world.
What my friends would call my best habit.
My favourite quote.
facts.body: “Remember that sometimes not getting what you want is a wonderful stroke of luck.” — attributed to the Dalai Lama
